title: Voyager plugin manifest
description: A declarative Voyager plugin (plugin.json). Hand-written to mirror validateManifest in src/features/plugins/manifest/validate.ts, which is the authority: this schema is editor tooling, not the gate. Run `bun run plugin:check <dir>` for the checks a schema cannot express (the site a plugin ships under, the primitives this build carries, translation completeness). Unknown top-level keys are ignored rather than rejected, exactly as the validator ignores them.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, so editors validate the file as you type.

description.description: English one-liner shown in the popup.

category.description: Classification. The known set is render-fix, theme, layout, readability, productivity, integration, other; any string is accepted so third parties are not boxed in.

engine.description: Semver range the plugin needs of the host engine: `*`, an exact `x.y.z`, or `>=x.y.z`. A plugin that invokes a primitive must set a floor at or above that primitive's `sinceEngine`, so an older Voyager says "update Voyager" instead of reporting a missing handler.

tier.description: `declarative` ships only data (CSS + JSON) interpreted by the bundled engine. `scripted` is reserved for a later advanced tier; the v1 engine applies only its declarative contributions.

matches.description: URL match patterns the plugin applies to. Every pattern must stay inside the matches of the site the plugin ships under (plan D18) — `plugin:check` enforces that; this schema cannot.

brand.description: Accent for Voyager's own UI on the matched site(s); overrides the site adapter's brandColor. Hex only — the value is concatenated into a CSS `color-mix(...)` expression.

theme.description: Optional brand accent contributed for the matched site(s).

format.description: Manifest format major. Absent means 1; published host catalogs always carry it.

requires.description: What the plugin needs from the host beyond the engine range. A miss disables the plugin with a reason (needs-handler / needs-semantic) instead of hiding it.

handlers.description: Primitive names the plugin invokes. Declaring them is optional for handlers already named by a `native` op, and required for anything a primitive is expected to provide implicitly.

semantic.description: Semantic selector keys the plugin expects its site adapter to define. See site.schema.json for the vocabulary.

changelog.description: One line describing this version, shown in the popup. When set, every locale in `i18n` needs a translated `changelog` too.

i18n.description: Localized metadata keyed by app language code. `en` is not needed — the top-level fields are the English copy, and every field falls back to them individually. `plugin:check` requires name and description (plus changelog and every setting label, when present) for ar, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh and zh_TW.

hexColor.description: A strict hex literal (3, 4, 6 or 8 digits), e.g. `#d97757`.

contributions.description: Everything the plugin adds to the page. New capabilities arrive as new keys here — a plugin never runs code of its own.

settings.description: User-configurable settings, rendered by the popup. A `{{key}}` placeholder in a DOM operation's value is replaced with the resolved setting.

styleContribution.description: CSS injected as a <style> element. Authors write `{ "file": "style.css" }`; the build inlines it as `{ "css": "…" }`, which is the form published catalogs carry. Classes must be `gv-` prefixed, and neither `@import` nor an external `url()` is allowed (no remotely-hosted resources).

file.description: Path to a .css file beside plugin.json. Relative, no `..`, no query or fragment.

source.description: The style file the CSS was inlined from. Written by the build.

selectorRef.description: Where an operation applies: a bare CSS selector string (sugar for `{"kind":"css"}`), an explicit css ref, or a semantic key the site adapter maps to a site-specific selector. Prefer semantic keys — a site redesign is then a one-file adapter fix.

domOperation.description: One reversible DOM operation interpreted by the bundled engine.

name.description: Event-handler attributes (on*) are rejected: they inject executable code.

value.description: javascript:, data: and vbscript: values are rejected for href, src, action, formaction and xlink:href.

styles.description: CSS property → value. An external url() is rejected.

oneOf.title: native
oneOf.description: Invoke a first-party primitive by name. `params` is configuration, never instructions; the primitive validates its own params. The engine floor must clear the primitive's sinceEngine — `plugin:check` enforces that.

params.description: Plain JSON configuration: primitives, arrays and objects of those, at most 4 levels deep, 50 keys or entries per level and 2000 chars per string.

label.description: English label. Every locale needs a translation under `i18n.<locale>.settings.<key>.label`.

minLabel.description: Label for the low end of a number/range control.

maxLabel.description: Label for the high end of a number/range control.

localization.description: One locale's copy. Every field is optional and falls back to the English original on its own.
